g.text: Stepwise shell growth from 80 to 100 ML
The series discussion gives 280 °C for 4–6 h; the 50-ML worked example explicitly states 4 h.
No exact individual duration is invented for 80 or 100 ML.
Separate nitrogen-filled three-neck round-bottom flask; its capacity and transferred volume
